options.label: Security
options.help: none: port 25. starttls: port 587, upgrade after EHLO. tls: port 465, TLS from the first byte. Certificates are always verified.

options.label: Measure until
options.help: banner: the server's 220 greeting. ehlo: also a complete answer to EHLO (including TLS when security is starttls or tls).

options.label: EHLO name
options.help: What we call ourselves in EHLO: letters, digits, dots and hyphens only
